description: Open and flowing. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: A large sofa/seating block sits centrally in the lower-left living zone facing the TV wall; a dining table with 6 chairs is positioned to the left near the kitchen counter.. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall left of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child. Not suitable for: households needing significant storage (no wardrobes shown); remote workers requiring a dedicated desk/home office; large families needing more than two bedrooms; anyone wanting bedrooms with strong natural light.
